affected_party: Organizations, successors, reviewers, operators, managers, and AI agents that must reproduce veteran judgment after experts retire
actual_problem: Tacit expert judgment often remains embedded in concrete cases and reviewer instincts, so organizations cannot reliably derive quality intent, exceptions, or loss boundaries from it.
why_it_matters: Without a structured extraction method, critical decisions drift, non-experts miss important cues, and AI agents cannot justify or reproduce high-stakes judgments.
why_now: QIF currently assumes quality intents can be discovered, but many organizations need a case-based path from tacit judgment to reusable decision patterns before expertise is lost.
